items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out with rib injury after being active pregame (hip Q expected to play).
items.why: Carted mid-game ribs; Schefter confirms ruled out (was expected/active from hip).
items.implication: Sit; SF WR targets redistribute rest of game.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury.
items.why: In-game thigh injury confirmed by Schefter.
items.implication: Immediate sit; Jets RB depth elevated rest of game/ROS if multi-week.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries surge vs DET.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs. Saints after knee issue; expected pregame.
items.why: Schefter/Rapoport/ETR expected then confirmed active for debut post-meniscus.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside if full; Mayer handcuff fades.
items.opportunity: High target share potential on return; red-zone role.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs with knee injury after limping off; coach Hafley 'does not sound very optimistic' on early eval, major concern.
items.why: In-game knee; Schefter/Rapoport + coach pessimism for significant injury.
items.implication: Sit rest of day/ROS worry; handcuff/backup surge.
items.opportunity: MIA RB committee or remaining backs elevated carries/targets.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs. Cowboys after GTD/hamstring and team not counting on him; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared; Schefter/Rapoport confirm active though limited expected.
items.implication: Startable but snap/route risk; Bateman/Andrews less boosted than if OUT.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets possible; monitor early usage.

items.text: Berry: Zay Flowers risky but if active for Ravens he's active for me; would start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active confirmation; prefers over Bateman despite risk/limit.
items.implication: Start Flowers in most formats if rostered.
items.conflict: Usage may be limited per Rapoport.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren expected then confirmed active vs. Bengals (shoulder Q).
items.implication: Start as usual; no major role change.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore active (shoulder Q, ETR projected limited); Keon Coleman also up.
items.why: Actives confirm; Levitan/ETR assumed in limited.
items.opportunity: Targets if limited volume still solid vs LAC.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell inactive (finger); Levitan details WR depth: Wilson 1, Isaiah Williams 2, Pritchett 3, Shepard 4, McLain 5; expects TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount. Mitchell had 12 targets prior week.
items.why: Fowler source + Levitan confirmation/projection update; ETR assumed out.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Wilson and Sadiq vs DET.

items.text: Levitan/ETR initially projecting Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring) Sunday AM with late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS; Moore limited/Mitchell out assumed. Updated as news broke to active.
items.why: Team not counting; projs set OUT pending workout.
items.implication: DFS pivot ready; actual active changed.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman expected to play (foot Q) then active; aligns Schefter reports.
items.why: ETR expected; Sunday AM reports confirm play.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith expected to play / off IR report good to go for MNF vs Bears (stinger prior for Barkley).
ETR Sunday AM comprehensive: Flowers GTD (not counting), Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending, Bagent. Aligns Schefter.
items.why: Full weekend reports parse for fantasy.
items.implication: Monitor windows; many expected cleared later.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week timeline per sources (ESPN/NFL Network); out this week, Bagent cleared but Keenum likely start MNF.
items.implication: Sit multiple weeks; Bears QB streamer/Keenum/Bagent.
items.opportunity: CHI pass catchers volatility; backup QB value short-term.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful (hip/groin) for SNF vs Broncos; could return next week but explosiveness impacted; McVay absent setback next week available.
items.why: Final report + Schefter notes on explosiveness.
items.opportunity: LAR WR2/TE targets up if out.

items.text: Bears QB Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol, no designation for MNF; Case Keenum likely to start vs Eagles.
items.why: Rapoport; Keenum preferred start despite clear.
items.implication: Bears QB is Keenum short-term with Williams out.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker up/active; Xavier Legette out (knee). ETR expected Coker.
Texans WR Nico Collins OUT (hamstring); known heading into weekend.
items.why: Final reports/Schefter prior; Schultz usage noted up previously.
